messages:
Riley (acct-exec): Klaxon procurement sent the SIG spreadsheet. They want Q3.2 (KMS rotation evidence), Q5.1 (SOC2 attestation), and Q7.2 (subprocessor list). Need artifacts and one-line answers by Friday COB. Who can take which?
Sam (security): I can take KMS rotation. I have a rotation policy and a scrubbed log snippet. Will upload.
Priya (legal): SOC2 exec summary is shareable; full report requires NDA. I can prepare the redacted exec summary.
Omar (infra): I'll draft the subprocessor CSV with customer-safe aliases and ping legal for review. Also Klaxon asked about short POC pricing; I'll add a pricing blurb.
Riley (acct-exec): Great. sec-bot, please ingest and return share links when ready. Tag artifacts customer=klaxon.
sec-bot: Uploading artifacts now. Please ensure logs are scrubbed before upload.
Sam (security): Uploaded: https://s3.redwood.internal/klaxon/kms-rotation-policy.pdf and https://s3.redwood.internal/klaxon/kms-rotation-log-20250201-scrubbed.txt
Priya (legal): SOC exec summary uploaded: https://s3.redwood.internal/klaxon/soc2-exec-summary-redacted.pdf. NDA note added for full report.
Omar (infra): Subprocessor draft uploaded and requested legal review: https://s3.redwood.internal/klaxon/subprocessors-draft.csv @Priya review
Priya (legal): Reviewed and cleared with aliases adjusted. Final file: https://s3.redwood.internal/klaxon/subprocessors-final.csv
Riley (acct-exec): Mapping for SIG answers: Q3.2 -> Sam (policy + log), Q5.1 -> Priya (exec summary), Q7.2 -> Omar (subprocessor final). POC pricing blurb for inclusion: "2-week Dedicated POC: $7,500 flat + per-token usage; contact pricing@redwood.com for details."
Sam (security): All good from my side. Logs scrubbed (key IDs/hostnames hashed).
sec-bot: All artifacts verified and tagged for Klaxon. Checksums OK.
Riley (acct-exec): I'll assemble the spreadsheet now and post the draft here for a quick check before submission. Aim to send to Klaxon Friday 17:00 PT. Flag any blockers ASAP.
